还好吧？

“大家”的审美水平很一般的，川普这种的也有好大一家喜欢，你看见川普会腿软走不动道吗？
所以“只有表现完美大家才会喜欢”只是一句胡话，属于反例摆满一桌子还犹自嫌弃“没有下筷处”的鬼扯蛋。
这话里面有**，所以反例摆满一桌子当事人还是要单吸这一口。
因为这话的真实版本是“等我表现完美，看谁能不喜欢我”。
ta不是在追求大家喜欢，而是在追求“任何人都不能不喜欢”。
人家才不是要来求你的欢心，人家是要来征服人类的。
前者会讲几个拿手笑话，会变几个小魔术，再卖点萌就行。
不信妞给大爷乐一个：
✖‿✖

大爷你假牙掉了。
(;´・`)>

后者要能徒手实现核聚变。
起码还要五十年。

班上一共就四十来个人，你也就需要萌倒10个就够你几年乐的了。你不要，你要研究手搓核聚变。
你问手搓核聚变搓不出来抑郁怎么办？
怎么办？
戴手套搓啊。

article.title: 炼血成丹
article.question: 感情上辜负了一个既深情又很好的女生，以后会遭报应吗?
article.brief:
那我怎么办？

出于显然的原因，我对对我表白的人是非常残忍无情的。

几乎全是毫无回应，期望自行冷却，遇到了因为一直得不到回应而情绪失控的，只能默默拉黑。

爱我的、默默爱我的不知有多少。

要论深情……唉……一声不吭、毫无回应的苦守，有些可能已经数年之久，如何不算深情？

至于
article.text:
那我怎么办？
出于显然的原因，我对对我表白的人是非常残忍无情的。
几乎全是毫无回应，期望自行冷却，遇到了因为一直得不到回应而情绪失控的，只能默默拉黑。
爱我的、默默爱我的不知有多少。
要论深情……唉……一声不吭、毫无回应的苦守，有些可能已经数年之久，如何不算深情？
至于好不好，敢自信能把我“拿下”的，总会有某种自信配得上我的原因。即使不是全部，恐怕也有相当一部分在一般人眼里看来不是一般人。
一言不发，算不算“辜负”？

情之一物，有时候没办法。
有缘有份乃是天注定，人只能顺从，无可勉强。
我其实和那种敬业的警察类似——我在这巡逻，是错过了子女的家长会、没见上父母最后一面、扛住了多少次发财的诱惑的结果。
正因为如此，不辜负子女、父母、家人这些已经付出的苦痛的办法，就是要把已经背负了如此多血泪的逻巡好，而绝不能是“抛弃岗位，回家抱娃”。
如果你是这种辜负，那么如果你相信对方是真爱，你就可以坚信对方最后一定会明白——其实自己的痛苦不是毫无果实的。
有果实，就不是毫无意义。
其实我们人类是不能选择是否痛苦的，我们只能选择无可避免的痛苦是否有意义，这也包括别人寄托在你身上的痛苦能不能有意义。

你们爱我，我也爱你们。
只是爱不是只有耳鬓厮磨、缱绻反侧。
爱还有隔云相望，炼血成丹。

这算不算辜负，不是流血的，无资格判断。
这有没有报应，不是主宰的，无权柄置喙。
我只有一种可选的亡羊补牢，就是让你们的痛苦不至于化为无谓。
这样还会不会有报应，不知道，但是我可以相信即使有报应，我也应该能闭得上眼。

If this cannot pass away,
except I drink it,
thy will be done.

article.text:
你最近跟我保持点距离。
怎么了？
                  离我太近，对你已经不安全了。
…………
你这算表白吗？
                  不算。
                  算友情通报。

                   对你我已经不用表白。
———————
亲密关系是心领神会的艺术，是表达的巅峰。
相爱的甜蜜，其根本的秘密在于两个做到了完美相互补强的人得以以超出自己梦想的程度传递自己无法对任何别人说出的意思。
双方共振到了这样的程度，以至于一声轻叹、一次轻瞥、一个微妙的用词选择、一次轻轻的触碰都能让她明白，让她明白你明白，让她明白你明白她明白。
只有你能以这样的好意和这样透彻地深知、如此准确地、毫无审判地判定她的意思，即使你的猜测错误，也极端可爱的错在她知道你会错在的过度善良、过度信任她的方向。
而她于你亦如是。
而这样的深知，又是靠相处时无间的互相凝视和如同镌刻一样的清晰记忆。所以你才有足够的信息去做那些要人命的双关和暗示。你们之间才有别人无法企及的同调。
这是在所谓的表白之前就应该达到的高度。
到了这个高度，哪怕耳边一句“那本书，能再借我一次吗？”都已经是表白。

只能借助“我喜欢你，我们交往吧”这种砖头般“表白”来让对方确信你的意思，本身就意味着你和对方的心灵协调达不到建立亲密关系的必要要求。

如果你和她达到了这样的程度，你要挑逗、魅惑她是轻而易举的。
单凭语言都能让她呻吟出声。
轻轻一碰她就站立不住。
贴近到耳边她会被你身上辐射的热量融化。
这所有的信号都是不间断的“表白”，是你身上这种疯狂的信息洪流和你让她胆战心惊的勇敢让她灵魂颤抖，心里滴水。
你是她的魔鬼，她是你的受害人，什么表白？
她只想和你一起在这堪称罪行的狂热里沉沦，哪怕地狱的烈火下一秒就来临，这一秒她都愿意流尽鲜血去握紧。

这份魅力，你只能被启发，不能被教授。
我就是示范给你看，你也无法照抄。因为抄袭而来的结果是假的，产生不了这种神力。
你只能自己抱着诚意，聪明地赌。
你真的那么爱，你就会有这样的心。
你有这个心，你就有这个力。
爱情是爱的极致，一旦你们尝到了这个心领神会的滋味，就会知道的。
爱人天生魅惑，但这不是靠那些话术技巧，而是靠出神入化的补强能力创造的神一般的天心通。
如果你真爱她，她的一言一笑自然过目不忘，
不要思虑怎样说话，或说什么话，而要深思什么是爱，而你爱不爱她。
到那时候，当说的话自必被赐给你们。

不用表，已然白。

                 对你我已经不用表白。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"———————","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"亲密关系是心领神会的艺术，是表达的巅峰。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"相爱的甜蜜，其根本的秘密在于两个做到了完美相互补强的人得以以超出自己梦想的程度传递自己无法对任何别人说出的意思。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"双方共振到了这样的程度，以至于一声轻叹、一次轻瞥、一个微妙的用词选择、一次轻轻的触碰都能让她明白，让她明白你明白，让她明白你明白她明白。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"只有你能以这样的好意和这样透彻地深知、如此准确地、毫无审判地判定她的意思，即使你的猜测错误，也极端可爱的错在她知道你会错在的过度善良、过度信任她的方向。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"而她于你亦如是。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"而这样的深知，又是靠相处时无间的互相凝视和如同镌刻一样的清晰记忆。所以你才有足够的信息去做那些要人命的双关和暗示。你们之间才有别人无法企及的同调。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这是在所谓的表白之前就应该达到的高度。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"到了这个高度，哪怕耳边一句“那本书，能再借我一次吗？”都已经是表白。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"只能借助“我喜欢你，我们交往吧”这种砖头般“表白”来让对方确信你的意思，本身就意味着你和对方的心灵协调达不到建立亲密关系的必要要求。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果你和她达到了这样的程度，你要挑逗、魅惑她是轻而易举的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"单凭语言都能让她呻吟出声。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"轻轻一碰她就站立不住。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"贴近到耳边她会被你身上辐射的热量融化。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这所有的信号都是不间断的“表白”，是你身上这种疯狂的信息洪流和你让她胆战心惊的勇敢让她灵魂颤抖，心里滴水。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你是她的魔鬼，她是你的受害人，什么表白？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"她只想和你一起在这堪称罪行的狂热里沉沦，哪怕地狱的烈火下一秒就来临，这一秒她都愿意流尽鲜血去握紧。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这份魅力，你只能被启发，不能被教授。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我就是示范给你看，你也无法照抄。因为抄袭而来的结果是假的，产生不了这种神力。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你只能自己抱着诚意，聪明地赌。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你真的那么爱，你就会有这样的心。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你有这个心，你就有这个力。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"爱情是爱的极致，一旦你们尝到了这个心领神会的滋味，就会知道的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"爱人天生魅惑，但这不是靠那些话术技巧，而是靠出神入化的补强能力创造的神一般的天心通。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果你真爱她，她的一言一笑自然过目不忘，","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不要思虑怎样说话，或说什么话，而要深思什么是爱，而你爱不爱她。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"到那时候，当说的话自必被赐给你们。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不用表，已然白。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

article.title: 王不见王
article.question: 月子里我妈要求岳父母表态，气得我老婆伤口渗液，我应该怎么做？
article.brief:
谈恋爱的资格门槛之一，是对方给了你一种信心，即ta所有的亲朋故旧的话你原则上都可以不必理会。结婚的资格门槛之一，是对方的行动果然做到了这一点。

具体来说，就是父母有什么请求，只能跟自己的子女说，子女自己过滤一遍，再考虑要不要传递给配偶。

配偶之间商量决定，决定了之后对抗各自父
article.text:
谈恋爱的资格门槛之一，是对方给了你一种信心，即ta所有的亲朋故旧的话你原则上都可以不必理会。结婚的资格门槛之一，是对方的行动果然做到了这一点。
具体来说，就是父母有什么请求，只能跟自己的子女说，子女自己过滤一遍，再考虑要不要传递给配偶。
配偶之间商量决定，决定了之后对抗各自父母的责任就全在自己身上，而不在配偶身上。
说白了，就是“王不见王”——岳父母跟女婿只能友善寒暄，根本没有发脾气、下指令的资格，反之公婆对儿媳也一样，有意见去跟自己儿子发作，对儿媳没有任何摆脸色的权利。
在你结婚那一刻起，父母于你只是客人。是贵客，但仍然是客。
如果发生了这种情况，没能管理住自己父母的一方要对另一方无条件的道歉。
因为我是作为成人和你这个成人交往，你必须是你自己的最终话事人，而绝不能搞成我来跟你的父母对阵，我来负责让你父母满意，你来为我没能让你的父母满意而惩罚我。
抱歉，我没有任何让你父母满意的义务。
是你自己的父母要尊重我作为一个绝对自由的公民的完全的自由，没有任何条件可讲。
这是我们可以开始亲密关系的前提，婚姻的基础。如果事后以任何形式证明这一承诺是空洞的，这就像中美建交是建立在一个中国原则上一样，你什么时候掏空，我们什么时候断交。
无可妥协。
你如果不认同，麻烦你不要贪恋我的美色、财富、权势、地位、才华，在我面前表演认同。
我不可能为了你能提供的那点其实对我毫不稀缺的殷勤小意而对你倾心。
能让我倾心的，恰恰是这种无需多言的对我的自由的毫无悬念的感知和尊重。你连这点意识都没有，意味着你甚至根本没把我当成一个不可侵犯的人来看待。
如果你不认同，你何止没有资格当我的爱人，连当我的敌人都不够资格。
不懂得我的自由绝不接受要挟，你的名字就不该在我的私人生活里被我发现有时常提起的必要。
无论这种决绝给我带来的是什么代价——说我不会有人喜欢也好、注定孤独一生也好——我都不会让步。
因为根本无步可让。

如果你拿你爱我或者我爱你为筹码来做这种要挟，那么请你把我一切让你有这类误解的行为列举出来，如果有，每一件我都单独向你道歉。
如果没有，你要向我道歉。
双方的歉道完，我们一样要回到这个决不妥协的原则上来。
我不勉强你接受，你不接受，我们就在情分没有完全耗尽之前体面分手。
没有任何妥协的余地。
类似题中描述的这类问题，根本就不该是婚姻内的问题。而应该是婚前就完全说清，甚至在恋爱前就确定无疑的基本共识。
“公婆安排我的生活”这件事会发生，就意味着你给了ta们“可以这么做”的幻想依据，这本身就是对我的背叛和欺骗。
这是你的绝对失职，不要跟我谈“传统”、“谈孝道”，没有用，没有意义。
因为在你没做到这个独立的成人的基本要求的时候，你已经失去了跟我说这些的资格。
你一旦打破了我对你的这点念想，你让我魂牵梦绕、甘愿为你的痛苦去忍受痛苦的那种力量就没了，你懂不懂？
你能唤起我强烈的服从的力量，在于对我是一个英雄，所以我为你肝脑涂地是一种荣耀，一种快乐。
一旦你让我看到你是这样一个根本无力自主、由人摆布，只能化身为别人对你的爱人下令的工具的人，那就完了。
我的君王，我所愿效死的是你。
如果你做了别人的奴隶，我就只能离开你了。
因为我没有选择你的“主人”。
你懂不懂？

一旦你放弃你自己的自由，你就根本不是我当初选择那个王了。
我很难向你解释，但是那已经不是我自己的主观意愿愿不愿意原谅你的问题。这就像这里本来要装一个钢齿轮，结果我现在发现它是塑料的。我一万个希望不要换，但这个轴上必须安装的是钢齿轮啊….
你明白吗？
一旦这种钢铁般的神力消失，单凭我自己对孤独的怯懦和对你的贪婪这个塑料齿轮，我将根本无力独力支撑。
就算我勉强去撑，我对你的恨意、对你的怨愤只会让我成为一眼毒泉，再也无法成为你幸福和快乐的来源。
我们之间，只在这一口气。
这一口气在，千难万难，终有尽时，鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已。
这一口气散了，则无论如何裱糊、敷衍、表演，剩下的都只有对自己没有勇气面对沉没成本的怨恨，和不敢面对自己的懦弱的迁怒。
恨屋及乌，殃及池鱼。
何苦呢？
更何况，我从来就不缺这种硬气，我不会容忍自己这种懦弱。
你想懦弱，我也不会替你成全。
无论如何，相识一场，我也不愿意你的下半生过成这样。
这你应该比谁都清楚。
就这样吧。
身为父母，自己要清楚，对自己子女的最大的爱，就是帮助自己长成一个完整健全的人。
不要贪图自己的“天伦之乐”，滥用子女对自己的依赖，擅自侵犯子女的人格边界。
一旦你侵犯了，成了年的子女将别无选择在自然法的强力勒令下对你做最决绝的报复。
因为你这么干了，你的子女的一切建立在ta的独立人格前提上的社会关系就将全部失效。
老板会开除在公司里大谈“我爸不让我xx”的员工。
合伙人会断然和“我妈反对”论者拆伙。
妻子、丈夫、恋人会和无力对抗你的子女分手、离婚。
ta还是个妈宝、爸宝，ta有什么资格和任何人签订任何条约？
别人应付ta一个人造成的问题和风险就已经到极限了，还要多应付两个上世纪的老神仙？
谁有这个闲心？
你伸手，ta就被弃，你的理由不重要，人家根本不需要理解，连听都不必听。
人家的这份权利是国家宪法绝对保证，由国家暴力机关承诺保护的。
你自以为的“天经地义”在此没有任何意义。
不要害了你的子女！

n":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"是你自己的父母要尊重我作为一个绝对自由的公民的完全的自由，没有任何条件可讲。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这是我们可以开始亲密关系的前提，婚姻的基础。如果事后以任何形式证明这一承诺是空洞的，这就像中美建交是建立在一个中国原则上一样，你什么时候掏空，我们什么时候断交。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"无可妥协。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你如果不认同，麻烦你不要贪恋我的美色、财富、权势、地位、才华，在我面前表演认同。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我不可能为了你能提供的那点其实对我毫不稀缺的殷勤小意而对你倾心。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"能让我倾心的，恰恰是这种无需多言的对我的自由的毫无悬念的感知和尊重。你连这点意识都没有，意味着你甚至根本没把我当成一个不可侵犯的人来看待。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果你不认同，你何止没有资格当我的爱人，连当我的敌人都不够资格。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不懂得我的自由绝不接受要挟，你的名字就不该在我的私人生活里被我发现有时常提起的必要。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"无论这种决绝给我带来的是什么代价——说我不会有人喜欢也好、注定孤独一生也好——我都不会让步。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"因为根本无步可让。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果你拿你爱我或者我爱你为筹码来做这种要挟，那么请你把我一切让你有这类误解的行为列举出来，如果有，每一件我都单独向你道歉。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果没有，你要向我道歉。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"双方的歉道完，我们一样要回到这个决不妥协的原则上来。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我不勉强你接受，你不接受，我们就在情分没有完全耗尽之前体面分手。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"没有任何妥协的余地。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"类似题中描述的这类问题，根本就不该是婚姻内的问题。而应该是婚前就完全说清，甚至在恋爱前就确定无疑的基本共识。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"“公婆安排我的生活”这件事会发生，就意味着你给了ta们“可以这么做”的幻想依据，这本身就是对我的背叛和欺骗。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这是你的绝对失职，不要跟我谈“传统”、“谈孝道”，没有用，没有意义。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"因为在你没做到这个独立的成人的基本要求的时候，你已经失去了跟我说这些的资格。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你一旦打破了我对你的这点念想，你让我魂牵梦绕、甘愿为你的痛苦去忍受痛苦的那种力量就没了，你懂不懂？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你能唤起我强烈的服从的力量，在于对我是一个英雄，所以我为你肝脑涂地是一种荣耀，一种快乐。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一旦你让我看到你是这样一个根本无力自主、由人摆布，只能化身为别人对你的爱人下令的工具的人，那就完了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我的君王，我所愿效死的是你。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果你做了别人的奴隶，我就只能离开你了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"因为我没有选择你的“主人”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h2"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你懂不懂？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一旦你放弃你自己的自由，你就根本不是我当初选择那个王了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我很难向你解释，但是那已经不是我自己的主观意愿愿不愿意原谅你的问题。这就像这里本来要装一个钢齿轮，结果我现在发现它是塑料的。我一万个希望不要换，但这个轴上必须安装的是钢齿轮啊….","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你明白吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一旦这种钢铁般的神力消失，单凭我自己对孤独的怯懦和对你的贪婪这个塑料齿轮，我将根本无力独力支撑。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"就算我勉强去撑，我对你的恨意、对你的怨愤只会让我成为一眼毒泉，再也无法成为你幸福和快乐的来源。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我们之间，只在这一口气。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这一口气在，千难万难，终有尽时，鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这一口气散了，则无论如何裱糊、敷衍、表演，剩下的都只有对自己没有勇气面对沉没成本的怨恨，和不敢面对自己的懦弱的迁怒。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"恨屋及乌，殃及池鱼。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"何苦呢？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"更何况，我从来就不缺这种硬气，我不会容忍自己这种懦弱。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你想懦弱，我也不会替你成全。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"无论如何，相识一场，我也不愿意你的下半生过成这样。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这你应该比谁都清楚。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"就这样吧。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"type":"horizontalrule","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"身为父母，自己要清楚，对自己子女的最大的爱，就是帮助自己长成一个完整健全的人。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不要贪图自己的“天伦之乐”，滥用子女对自己的依赖，擅自侵犯子女的人格边界。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一旦你侵犯了，成了年的子女将别无选择在自然法的强力勒令下对你做最决绝的报复。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"因为你这么干了，你的子女的一切建立在ta的独立人格前提上的社会关系就将全部失效。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"老板会开除在公司里大谈“我爸不让我xx”的员工。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"合伙人会断然和“我妈反对”论者拆伙。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"妻子、丈夫、恋人会和无力对抗你的子女分手、离婚。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ta还是个妈宝、爸宝，ta有什么资格和任何人签订任何条约？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"别人应付ta一个人造成的问题和风险就已经到极限了，还要多应付两个上世纪的老神仙？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"谁有这个闲心？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你伸手，ta就被弃，你的理由不重要，人家根本不需要理解，连听都不必听。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"人家的这份权利是国家宪法绝对保证，由国家暴力机关承诺保护的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你自以为的“天经地义”在此没有任何意义。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不要害了你的子女！","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

article.title: 天凉好个秋
article.question: 网文与名著的本质区别在哪里？
article.brief:
名著往往是四十岁以后的作者写出来的，有些甚至年纪更大。

多半自己久历沧桑。

所以往往能在看似平淡的语言里渗透鲜血，在一片安静中燃烧激情。

因为那些伤自己受过，那些激情已经经历过，知道只要稍加勾画、暗示，都已经足够触动同样经历过的读者们那些刻骨铭心的记忆。

曾经撕心裂肺的旧
article.text:
名著往往是四十岁以后的作者写出来的，有些甚至年纪更大。
多半自己久历沧桑。
所以往往能在看似平淡的语言里渗透鲜血，在一片安静中燃烧激情。
因为那些伤自己受过，那些激情已经经历过，知道只要稍加勾画、暗示，都已经足够触动同样经历过的读者们那些刻骨铭心的记忆。
曾经撕心裂肺的旧伤，一触即痛，自然就不会因为害怕读者没反应而抡圆了刀砍斧剁了。
碧云天，黄花地，西风紧，北雁南飞。
欲语还休，天凉，真好个秋。

网文往往是四十岁以下的青年甚至少年写出来的。又被更新的节奏所逼，被“订阅数”的需求所诱，为了怕读者觉得没看点，不免辞藻华丽、场面绚烂、锣鼓喧天。
但喧闹之后，往往黄粱一梦，只觉得寂寞。

article.title: 哈尔佛
article.question: 好人历经八十一难，才能成佛，而恶人只要放下屠刀，就能立地成佛，这种观念怎么来的？
article.brief:
有一种很猥琐但很有生命力的幻想，你可以叫它“慕恶”。

具体来说，就是把充满罪恶的生活想象得相当美好，既没有恐惧仓皇，也没有寝食难安，又没有风声鹤唳，又没有勾心斗角，又没有疑神疑鬼。毫无良心自责，也无妻离子散、众叛亲离。而且吃香的、喝辣的、睡美的、杀恨的、玩爽的。

一切社会规则
article.text:
有一种很猥琐但很有生命力的幻想，你可以叫它“慕恶”。
具体来说，就是把充满罪恶的生活想象得相当美好，既没有恐惧仓皇，也没有寝食难安，又没有风声鹤唳，又没有勾心斗角，又没有疑神疑鬼。毫无良心自责，也无妻离子散、众叛亲离。而且吃香的、喝辣的、睡美的、杀恨的、玩爽的。
一切社会规则都被证明是泥菩萨，一切正义的力量都被确信是纸老虎。
最后只要轻轻放下屠刀，简直人生完美。
这就叫慕恶。
好人九九八十一难，是为义受逼迫，这本来就是幼稚的善要演化到成熟的善必经的锻炼过程，一种类似训练科目、撸铁的酸痛一样的磨砺。
坏人没有为义受逼迫，于是一路酒肉美女坐等招安，是吗？
ta放下屠刀之前必须在修罗地狱里活活的先煎熬半辈子。
何止八十一难，ta是就一难都要难个几十年。难就没停过，就没睡过一个安稳觉，没过过一个不用疑神疑鬼的日子，没法用“这个是灾难1，那个是灾难2”的逻辑去数有几个灾难。
另外你把“立地成佛”想得太美好了。成佛第一件事就是剜肉剔骨赎罪，不是“换了职业一切清零”。否则这点良知都没有，成了个啥佛？哈儿佛吗？
坏人放下屠刀前要不是已经被修罗地狱磨得一丝念想都没有了，不是生了死志，不是已经确信“舍了这已经无救的人生，换最后一段的安宁也好”，ta这屠刀贷款都没还完，ta怎么可能放得下？
到了这一步，ta八十一难已经挨了几十年了，你还觉得ta占了大便宜吗？
